# Helper functions
```{r}
read.in.data <- function(seurat.obj, dataset.id, sample.id.col, individual.id.col, diagnosis.col, timepoint.col, downsample = F, dataset.fine.col = NA, diagnosis.fine.col = NA) {
  
  seurat.obj$dataset.id <- dataset.id
  
  if (!is.na(dataset.fine.col)) {
    if (dataset.fine.col %in% colnames(seurat.obj@meta.data)) {
      seurat.obj$dataset.fine <- seurat.obj[[dataset.fine.col]]
    } else {
      seurat.obj$dataset.fine <- dataset.fine.col
    }
  } else {
    seurat.obj$dataset.fine <- dataset.id
  }
  
  if (sample.id.col %in% colnames(seurat.obj@meta.data)) {
    seurat.obj$sample.id <- seurat.obj[[sample.id.col]]
  } else {
    seurat.obj$sample.id <- sample.id.col
  }
  
  if (individual.id.col %in% colnames(seurat.obj@meta.data)) {
    seurat.obj$individual.id <- seurat.obj[[individual.id.col]]
  } else {
    seurat.obj$individual.id <- individual.id.col
  }
  
  if (diagnosis.col %in% colnames(seurat.obj@meta.data)) {
    seurat.obj$diagnosis <- seurat.obj[[diagnosis.col]]
  } else {
    seurat.obj$diagnosis <- diagnosis.col
  }
  
  if (!is.na(diagnosis.fine.col)) {
    if (diagnosis.fine.col %in% colnames(seurat.obj@meta.data)) {
      seurat.obj$diagnosis.fine <- seurat.obj[[diagnosis.fine.col]]
    } else {
      seurat.obj$diagnosis.fine <- diagnosis.fine.col
    }
  } else {
    seurat.obj$diagnosis.fine <- seurat.obj$diagnosis
  }
  
  if (timepoint.col %in% colnames(seurat.obj@meta.data)) {
    seurat.obj$timepoint <- seurat.obj[[timepoint.col]]
  } else {
    seurat.obj$timepoint <- timepoint.col
  }
  
  seurat.obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat.obj, pattern = "^MT-") 
  
  if (dataset.id == "Velmeshev 2019") {
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = cluster == "Oligodendrocytes")
  } else if (dataset.id == "Herring 2022") {
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = major_clust == "Oligo")
  } else if (dataset.id == "Macnair 2024 MS") {
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = type_broad == "Oligodendrocytes")
  } else if (dataset.id == "Garza 2023 TBI") {
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = seurat_clusters == "1")
  } else if (dataset.id == "Sussman 2024") {
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (annotation.l2 == "Oligodendrocytes"))
  } else if (dataset.id == "This study") {
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = (predicted.annotation_l2 == "Oligodendrocytes"))
  } else if (dataset.id == "Wang 2022") {
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = cell_type == "Oligodendrocyte")
  } else if (dataset.id == "Nomura 2025") {
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = CellType == "Oligodendrocyte")
  } else if (dataset.id == "Blanco-Carmona 2023") {
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = NMF_labelling == "Oligodendrocytes")
  } else if (dataset.id == "Mikolajewicz 2026") {
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = cell_type == "oligodendrocyte")
  } else {
    stop(paste("unknown dataset id:", dataset.id))
  }
  
  seurat.obj.subset$predicted.cell.type <- "Oligodendrocyte"
  print(dim(seurat.obj.subset))
  
  if (downsample) {
    seurat.obj.subset$dataset.celltype <- paste(seurat.obj.subset$dataset.id, seurat.obj.subset$predicted.cell.type)
    Idents(seurat.obj.subset) <- "dataset.celltype"
    seurat.obj.subset$downsample <- TRUE
    seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.subset, subset = downsample == TRUE, downsample = 10000)
  }
  return(seurat.obj.subset)
}
```



# MS (Macnair et al., 2024)
```{r}
seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "Macnair_2024_MS/", "Mcnair_2024_MS.RDS"))
seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = type_broad == "Oligodendrocytes")

seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj)

seurat.obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat.obj, pattern = "^MT-") 
seurat.obj$low.quality.by.qc <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) < nCount_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['nFeature_RNA']]) < nFeature_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['percent.mt']]) > percent.mt.cutoff))

seurat.obj$diagnosis.original <- seurat.obj$diagnosis
seurat.obj$diagnosis.broad <- sapply(seurat.obj$diagnosis.original, function(x) case_when (x == "CTR" ~ "Control", 
                                                                  x %in% c("SPMS", "PPMS", "RRMS") ~ "MS",
                                                                  .default = x))
seurat.obj$matter.original <- seurat.obj$matter
seurat.obj$matter <- sapply(seurat.obj$matter.original, function(x) ifelse(x == "GM", "Grey Matter", "White Matter"))

seurat.obj$diagnosis <- paste0(seurat.obj$diagnosis.broad, " ", seurat.obj$matter)
seurat.obj$diagnosis.fine <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(row[["diagnosis.original"]] == "CTR", paste("Control", row[["matter"]]), paste(row[["diagnosis.original"]], row["matter"])))

macnair2024.seurat.obj <- read.in.data(seurat.obj = seurat.obj,
                          dataset.id = "Macnair 2024 MS",
                          sample.id.col = "sample_id_anon",
                          individual.id.col = "individual_id_anon",
                          timepoint = "Postmortem",
                          diagnosis.col = "diagnosis",
                          dataset.fine.col = "sample_source",
                          diagnosis.fine.col = "diagnosis.fine",
                          downsample = F)

macnair2024.seurat.obj <- add.module.score(macnair2024.seurat.obj, oligo.gene.signatures)




VlnPlot(macnair2024.seurat.obj, group.by = "lesion_type", features = c("BCAS1", "ASPA", "OLIG2", "SOX10"), flip = T, stack = T, sort = T)  + stat_summary(fun.y = median, geom='point', size = 20, colour = "black", shape = 95)

oligo.df <- macnair2024.seurat.obj@meta.data %>%
  group_by(lesion_type, diagnosis, diagnosis.fine, individual.id, sample.id, sample_source, matter) %>%
  summarize(mean.oligo.like = mean(reactive.oligo.general),
            count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()


oligo.df$diagnosis <- factor(oligo.df$diagnosis, levels = c("Control Grey Matter", "MS Grey Matter", "Control White Matter", "MS White Matter"))
p <- ggplot(oligo.df, aes(diagnosis, mean.oligo.like)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill=matter), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)) +
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=16), axis.title=element_text(size=20,face="bold"), plot.title = element_text(size=24)) +
  xlab("Lesion type") +
  ylab("Reactive oligo signature\nin oligodendrocytes") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  stat_compare_means(ref.group = "Control White Matter", label = "p.format")
pdf(paste0(results.dir, "DatasetsCombined/", "oligo_like_signature/", "oligodendrocytes/", "diagnosis_vs_mean.oligo.signature.pdf"), width = 12, height = 8)  
print(p)
dev.off()

oligo.df.filter <- oligo.df %>% filter(lesion_type %in% c("WM", "NAWM", "CAL"))

control.wm <- "Control\nwhite matter"
ms.nawm <- "Multiple sclerosis normal-appearing\nwhite matter"
ms.cal.wm <- "Multiple sclerosis chronic active\ndemyelinating lesion\nwhite matter"

oligo.df.filter$diagnosis <- sapply(oligo.df.filter$lesion_type, function(x) case_when(
  x == "WM" ~ control.wm,
  x == "NAWM" ~ ms.nawm,
  x == "CAL" ~ ms.cal.wm
))
oligo.df.filter$disease <- sapply(oligo.df.filter$lesion_type, function(x) ifelse(x == "WM", FALSE, TRUE))
oligo.df.filter$diagnosis <- factor(oligo.df.filter$diagnosis, levels = c(control.wm, ms.nawm, ms.cal.wm))
stat.test <- oligo.df.filter %>%
    wilcox_test(mean.oligo.like ~ diagnosis, comparisons = list(c(control.wm, ms.cal.wm), c(ms.nawm, ms.cal.wm), c(control.wm, ms.nawm))) %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    add_xy_position()
stat.test$p.label <- paste0("p = ", stat.test$p.adj)
stat.test.ms <- stat.test

p <- ggplot(oligo.df.filter, aes(diagnosis, mean.oligo.like)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = disease), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2) +
  theme(legend.position="none", axis.text=element_text(size=16), axis.title=element_text(size=20,face="bold"), plot.title = element_text(size=24)) +
  xlab("Lesion type") +
  ylab("Reactive oligo signature\nin oligodendrocytes") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.label", label.size = 6)
pdf(paste0(results.dir, "DatasetsCombined/", "oligo_like_signature/", "oligodendrocytes/", "MS_diagnosis_vs_mean.oligo.signature.pdf"), width = 12, height = 8)  
print(p)
dev.off()
```

# TBI (Garza et al., 2023)
```{r}
tbi.results <- readRDS(paste0(data.dir, "Garza_2023_TBI/TBI_Garza_2023/output/merged/ALL_Harmony/results-merged.rds"))
seurat.obj <- tbi.results[,1]$scds

seurat.obj$diagnosis <- sapply(seurat.obj$sample, function(x) ifelse(grepl("HuBrainCTL", x), "Control", "Traumatic brain injury"))
seurat.obj$individual.id <- sapply(seurat.obj$sample, function(x) str_replace(unlist(str_split(x, "_"))[3], "F|T", ""))
seurat.obj$timepoint <- sapply(seurat.obj$sample, function(x) ifelse(grepl("HuBrainCTL", x), "Postmortem", "Initial"))

tbi.seurat.obj <- read.in.data(seurat.obj = seurat.obj,
                      dataset.id = "Garza 2023 TBI",
                      sample.id.col = "sample",
                      individual.id.col = "individual.id",
                      timepoint.col = "timepoint",
                      diagnosis.col = "diagnosis",
                      downsample = F)
tbi.seurat.obj[["RNA"]] <- as(object = tbi.seurat.obj[["RNA"]], Class = "Assay5") # convert from Seurat 4 to Seurat 5
tbi.seurat.obj <- add.module.score(tbi.seurat.obj, oligo.gene.signatures)

tbi.seurat.obj.oligo <- tbi.seurat.obj

oligo.df <- tbi.seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data %>%
  group_by(diagnosis, diagnosis.fine, individual.id, sample.id) %>%
  summarize(mean.oligo.like = mean(reactive.oligo.general)) %>%
  ungroup()
oligo.df$disease <- sapply(oligo.df$diagnosis, function(x) x == "Traumatic brain injury")

stat.test <- oligo.df %>%
    wilcox_test(mean.oligo.like ~ diagnosis) %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    add_xy_position()
stat.test$p.label <- paste0("p = ", stat.test$p.adj)
stat.test.tbi <- stat.test

p <- ggplot(oligo.df, aes(diagnosis, mean.oligo.like)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill=diagnosis), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2) +
  theme(legend.position="none", axis.text=element_text(size=16), axis.title=element_text(size=20,face="bold"), plot.title = element_text(size=24)) +
  xlab("Sample") +
  ylab("Reactive oligo signature\nin oligodendrocytes") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.label", label.size = 6)
pdf(paste0(results.dir, "DatasetsCombined/", "oligo_like_signature/", "oligodendrocytes/", "TBI_diagnosis_vs_mean.oligo.signature.pdf"), width = 8, height = 6)  
print(p)
dev.off()
```



# MS and TBI combined one plot
```{r}
oligo.df.ms <- oligo.df.filter
oligo.df.ms <- oligo.df.ms %>% dplyr::select(diagnosis, mean.oligo.like, disease)
oligo.df.ms$dataset.id <- "Macnair et al. 2024 | multiple sclerosis"

oligo.df.tbi <- oligo.df
oligo.df.tbi <- oligo.df.tbi %>% dplyr::select(diagnosis, mean.oligo.like, disease)
oligo.df.tbi$dataset.id <- "Garza et al. 2023 | traumatic brain injury"

oligo.df <- rbind(oligo.df.ms, oligo.df.tbi)

stat.test <- oligo.df %>%
  group_by(dataset.id) %>%
  wilcox_test(mean.oligo.like ~ diagnosis) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_xy_position()
stat.test$p.label <- paste0("p = ", round(stat.test$p.adj, 3))
stat.test$xmin[1] <- 1
stat.test$xmax[1] <- 2

p <- ggplot(oligo.df, aes(diagnosis, mean.oligo.like)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill=disease), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme(legend.position="none", axis.text=element_text(size=16), axis.title=element_text(size=20,face="bold"), plot.title = element_text(size=24)) +
  xlab("Sample") +
  ylab("Reactive oligodendrocyte signature\nin oligodendrocytes") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.label", label.size = 6) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45, 
      hjust = 1 
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~dataset.id, scales = "free_x")


# save this in the main figures dir
pdf(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 4/", "MS_and_TBI_diagnosis_vs_reactive_oligo_signature.pdf"), width = 12, height = 9)  
print(p)
dev.off()
```



# Read in datasets and merging
```{r}
datasets <- list()



##### Healthy/Control oligodendrocytes #####

velmeshev2019.seurat.obj <- read.in.data(seurat.obj = seurat.obj,
                      dataset.id = "Velmeshev 2019",
                      sample.id.col = "sample",
                      individual.id.col = "individual",
                      timepoint = "Postmortem",
                      diagnosis.col = "Control")


data <- FetchData(velmeshev2019.seurat.obj, vars = c("BCAS1", "ASPA"))

datasets[["Sussman 2024 pHGG"]] <- sussman2024.seurat.obj




##### This study #####
seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(results.dir, "my_data/", "autopsy/", "all_postmortem_samples_cellbender.FALSE_denoise.heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature_filter.FALSE_batch.correction.None/", "oligodendrocytes/", "all_postmortem_samples_oligodendrocytes.RDS"))
seurat.obj$diagnosis <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) case_when(
  row[["sample.id"]] == "P4 A15" ~ "IDH-mut",
  row[["location"]] == "Distal" ~ "Control",
  TRUE ~ "GBM"
))
seurat.obj$diagnosis.fine <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) case_when(
  row[["sample.id"]] == "P4 A15" ~ "IDH-A: Postmortem",
  row[["location"]] == "Distal" ~ "GBM: Control",

  x %in% c("NCH302", "NCH645") ~ 3,
  x %in% c("NCH988", "NCH2375") ~ 4,
  x %in% c("NCH740W", "NCH2367") ~ 5,
  x %in% c("NCH673D", "NCH2260") ~ 6
))

  print(DefaultAssay(x))
  DefaultAssay(x) <- "RNA"
  x[["SCT"]] <- NULL
  if (length(overlapping.genes) == 0) {
    overlapping.genes <- rownames(x)
  } else {
    overlapping.genes <- intersect(overlapping.genes, rownames(x))
  }
}
print(length(overlapping.genes))




merged.seurat.obj <- merge(datasets[[1]], datasets[2:length(datasets)], add.cell.ids = names(datasets), merge.data = F)
merged.seurat.obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(merged.seurat.obj[["RNA"]])
merged.seurat.obj <- merged.seurat.obj[overlapping.genes, ]
merged.seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(merged.seurat.obj)

set.seed(123)
oligo.jakel2019.signatures[["Oligo4"]] <- NULL # missing gene
merged.seurat.obj <- add.module.score(merged.seurat.obj, oligo.gene.signatures)
merged.seurat.obj <- add.module.score(merged.seurat.obj, gene.signatures)
merged.seurat.obj <- add.module.score(merged.seurat.obj, oligo.jakel2019.signatures)
merged.seurat.obj <- add.module.score(merged.seurat.obj, gene.signatures.gsea)
merged.seurat.obj <- add.module.score(merged.seurat.obj, myelination.signatures)
merged.seurat.obj <- add.module.score(merged.seurat.obj, fgfr.gene.signatures)


saveRDS(merged.seurat.obj, paste0(results.dir, "DatasetsCombined/", "merged.oligo.seurat.obj.RDS"))
```

# Figure 4: Diagnosis vs reactive oligodendrocyte signature
```{r}
oligo.df <- df

stat.test <- oligo.df %>%
  wilcox_test(
    mean.reactive.oligo.general ~ diagnosis,
  ) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "diagnosis")
stat.test$p.label <- format.p.value(stat.test$p.adj)

p <- ggplot(oligo.df, aes(diagnosis, mean.reactive.oligo.general, color = dataset.id)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2), alpha = 0.6) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) +
  xlab("Diagnosis") +
  ylab("Reactive oligodendrocyte signature\nin oligodendrocytes") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "p.label",
    size = 6
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = as.character(polychrome(length(unique(oligo.df$dataset.id))))) +
  labs(color = "Dataset")
pdf(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 4/", "diagnosis_vs_reactive_oligo_signature_in_glioma_datasets.pdf"), width = 12, height = 9)  
print(p)
dev.off()


# by disease and dataset
stat.test <- oligo.df %>%
  wilcox_test(
    mean.reactive.oligo.general ~ diagnosis_dataset
  ) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%

stat.test <- stat.test %>% filter(p.adj < 0.05)
stat.test$p.label <- format.p.value(stat.test$p.adj)

p <- ggplot(oligo.df, aes(diagnosis_dataset, mean.reactive.oligo.general, color = diagnosis_dataset)) +

  )
```

```{r}
    mean.reactive.oligo.general ~ timepoint,
    paired = T
  ) %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "timepoint")
stat.test$p.label <- format.p.value(stat.test$p)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(timepoint, mean.reactive.oligo.general)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + 
  geom_line(aes(group = individual.id)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) +
  xlab("Diagnosis") +
  ylab("Reactive oligodendrocyte signature\nin oligodendrocytes") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "p.label",
    size = 6
  ) +
  ggtitle("Mikolajewicz 2026 GBM")

pdf(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 5/", "timepoint_vs_reactive_oligo_signature_mikolajewicz2026.pdf"), width = 8, height = 8)  
print(p)
dev.off()

```

```{r}
# grade vs oligo signature (Blanco-Carmona 2023 IDH-mutant glioma)

  filter(dataset.id == "Blanco-Carmona 2023") %>%
```
